Preserve the venue entrance, sunset waterfront, walkable ground, perspective and detailed illustrated style.

Realistic lighting/materials and adult-proportioned vendor; no additional performers on the empty stage.

Detailed illustrated VIP lounge matching the existing room layout. Central photo backdrop with @thekingdomcircuit, red carpet, warm brick, lounge furniture and refreshment station, large Kingdom Circuit wall logo; clear central space for the game characters.

Transparent six-column, two-row character sheet. Detailed illustrated adults with realistic proportions, distinct faces, outfits and inclusive skin tones, including the main red player, green friend and purple friend. Approximately 24 Black, six Latino and six white people, men and women. No repeated people, no backgrounds; clear cell spacing.
